spans.view: with a row of glass-door fridges behind him

beats.text: Pax bounces from foot to foot with a wide smile, hugging an armful of snack packs and holding one packet up high
Pax squeezes his eyes shut in a happy grin while a chocolate bar slides out from under his armful
Pax opens his eyes and keeps bouncing while a chocolate bar drops and lands on its end on the floor
Pax hops from foot to foot hugging his snacks while a dropped chocolate bar tips over and lies flat

spans.notes: steady push-in through the whole shot: Pax and the fridges grow together (fridge top edge drops from y~110 to y~65 px in full-res crops f139/f169/f199, door frames thicken), the dropped bar drifts left toward the edge as the view tightens; ECC on the fridge band at the left edge scale 1.01 -> 1.14 over f186-199 (cc 0.81-0.96, background soft-focus). Pax walks in place, no travel. Snack packs carry invented parody names (Fingles, Rocky, Orceos, Snowckers, Polar ...), not real brand names, so in-world packaging text under the brand ruling (same as the parody mayonnaise label precedent); never transcribed.
